description: Source code for the LunarView class, implementing a SurfaceView and nested LunarThread for a simple LunarLander game. Contains game logic, rendering, physics updates, and input handling for the game.

classes.name: LunarView
classes.description: Custom SurfaceView that handles rendering, input, and game logic for the LunarLander game.

classes.name: LunarThread
classes.description: Inner class extending Thread that manages game loop, physics updates, rendering, and state management.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main game loop executing physics updates and rendering while the game is active.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Initializes game parameters based on difficulty and starts gameplay.

methods.name: pause
methods.description: Pauses the game physics and animation.

methods.name: restoreState
methods.description: Restores game state from a Bundle, typically during activity recreation.

methods.name: setDifficulty
methods.description: Sets the difficulty level for the game.

methods.name: setFiring
methods.description: Sets whether the engine is firing, affecting physics and visuals.

methods.name: setRunning
methods.description: Controls whether the game thread should run or stop.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Updates the game mode/state (e.g., running, paused, game over).

methods.name: surfaceCreated
methods.description: Starts the game thread once the surface is ready.

methods.name: surfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Stops the game thread when the surface is destroyed.

methods.name: doDraw
methods.description: Handles all drawing operations for the current game frame.

methods.name: updatePhysics
methods.description: Calculates new position, velocity, and game state based on elapsed time.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key press events for game controls.

methods.name: onKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key release events for game controls.
